mapper.select: select mgs.goods_id, mgb.goods_name, mgs.goods_stock, mgs.goods_alarm, mgb.goods_image, mgb.goods_spec, mgs.create_time, mgs.update_time from ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_stock mgs left join ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_base mgb on mgs.goods_id = mgb.goods_id where mgb.shop_id = #{param.shopId} and mgs.goods_id = #{param.goodsId}
SELECT mgb.goods_id as goodsId, mgb.goods_alarm as goodsAlarm, mgb.goods_stock as goodsStock, mgb.common_id as commonId FROM ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_base mgb GROUP BY mgb.goods_id
